items.headline: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
items.summary: Moody's said AI spending is forcing even the world's most cash-rich corporations to lean heavily on debt, stock sales and off-balance-sheet moves.

items.headline: Trump threatens EU with 'substantial TARIFF' for 'ROBBING' U.S. tech giants
items.summary: Trump on Truth Social railed against the European Union's new fine on Google and prior penalties against U.S. tech giants Apple, Meta and Amazon.

items.headline: Nvidia, Microsoft urge US to avoid broad restrictions on open AI models
items.summary: Nvidia, Microsoft and Meta urge US policymakers not to broadly restrict open-weight AI models amid a growing debate over AI regulation

items.headline: Stocks Fall Sharply as Crude Oil Prices Soar and Alphabet Sparks AI Spending Concerns
Amazon CEO Jassy may deliver a July 30 AWS earnings shock
items.summary: Amazon has long derived a disproportionate share of its profit from its cloud division, Amazon Web Services (AWS). A growing number of Wall Street analysts are now projecting AWS will exceed consensus growth estimates when CEO Andy Jassy reports second-quarter results on July 30, The Motley Fool ...

items.headline: BofA sees 5-year Treasury bond bear market ending
items.summary: Long-term Treasury bonds have delivered one of their worst stretches in modern history, with prices falling steadily since 2021 as inflation remained above the Federal Reserve’s target.  Investors who owned 10-year and 30-year government debt watched the value of those holdings erode quarter ...

items.headline: Oil falls on report Pakistan is pushing for new U.S.-Iran talks with China's backing
items.summary: Oil prices dropped by around 3% on Friday, but remained on track for a weekly jump of 10% as the U.S.-Iran war continued to escalate.

items.headline: Elon Musk Has Lost This Much Money as SpaceX, Tesla Stock Tank
items.summary: Tesla and SpaceX stock, as investors know, have gotten hammered this week, and the drops have cost Elon Musk a boatload of money.

items.headline: Dow Jones Futures: Apple Earnings, Iran News, Fed Meeting Loom As AI Stocks Sell Off
items.summary: Dow Jones futures will open Sunday evening, along with S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq futures. Apple, Microsoft, Meta Platforms, Amazon.com headline a massive earnings wave. The Federal Reserve meets, with a rate hike a possibility.

items.headline: Stocks Just Topped Crypto on Hyperliquid. ARK Says That Changes Everything
items.summary: For the first time, real-world assets—stocks, commodities, and market indices—outpaced crypto on the world's biggest decentralized derivatives exchange.

items.headline: Musk's bad week: Tesla suffers worst slump since 2022, SpaceX drops ahead of Starship test flight
items.summary: Tesla shares plunged almost 18% this week after the company missed on earnings and turned cash flow negative.

items.headline: ICAP: A Primer On The Infrastructure Capital Equity Income ETF (NYSEARCA:ICAP)
items.summary: Explore Infrastructure Capital Equity Income ETF: ~9.8% yield via leverage, preferreds & covered calls—plus risks vs. JEPI/DIVO.

items.headline: The Fat Tail Risks Hiding In Plain Sight (NYSEARCA:IWD)
items.summary: US-Iran tensions raise fat-tail risks for oil as US/Japan/Europe reserves near depletion; meme stocks like TSLA, PLTR vulnerable.

items.headline: Paramount agrees to delay WBD acquisition to as late as June 2027 amid legal challenge
items.summary: Paramount previously said it intended to complete its WBD acquisition by the end of September, but said Friday the agreement is a "significant win."

items.headline: Why bond investors are pushing up some of your interest rates
items.summary: Many types of consumer loans such as mortgages peg their interest rate to the yield on 10-year Treasury bonds, which has been moving higher.

items.headline: Trump defends DOJ subpoenas of NY Times reporters; Google also was targeted
items.summary: The DOJ is investigating the leak to The New York Times of security concerns about President Donald Trump's new Air Force One plane, donated by Qatar.

items.headline: Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex budgets
items.summary: Google, Amazon and Meta are seeing credit spreads widen as fixed-income investors demand more reward on companies they lend to.

items.headline: Strait of Hormuz traffic may not return to normal for 12 months or more, according to prediction markets
items.summary: Kalshi traders give less than 50% odds that the key maritime passageway will fully reopen by July 2027.

items.headline: CDC says massive cyclospora outbreak is now in nine states
items.summary: The four newly linked states — Illinois, Kansas, Oklahoma and Pennsylvania — join Indiana, Kentucky, Ohio, West Virginia and hard-hit Michigan.

items.headline: 1 hyperscaler megacap down, 3 to go. Alphabet raises the stakes on AI spending
items.summary: "Capex trends are going to be the number one focus," Club portfolio director Jeff Marks said Friday ahead of next week's Big Tech earnings.
